preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The string must contain only alphabetic characters.
The string must not be empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(int(d) for d in str(total1)) - sum(int(d) for d in str(total2)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the difference between the sum of the digits in total1 and total2.
